reason: LSGQuant applies layer-sensitivity-guided quantization and mixed-precision refinement to one-step diffusion video-super-resolution DiTs. It reports quality near full precision and gains over other quantizers, but is task-specific diffusion generation rather than LLM quantization/serving; transfer to the linked learned-rotation LLM quantization family is uncertain.
title: LSGQuant: Layer-Sensitivity Guided Quantization for One-Step Diffusion Real-World Video Super-Resolution
